question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services?
acceptance: November30,2022 at 4:30pm HST; issue date and RFP number optional.
candidate_answer: The proposal deadline was **November 30, 2022, at 4:30 p.m. Hawaii Standard Time**. ERS had to receive proposals by then. Source: Hawaii ERS Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06, pp. 6–7.
